head: Five points for McDavid as the Oilers beat the Mammoth
paras: Zach Hyman was back in the lineup after missing six games. Connor McDavid opened the scoring for the Oilers just 40 seconds into the game, and Hyman made it 2-0 on the power play midway through the first. Mathieu Joseph scored his first goal for Edmonton 32 seconds later to make it 3-0. Trent Frederic and Jack McBain dropped the gloves late in the first. Kasperi Kapanen and Leon Draisaitl scored just under three minutes apart midway through the second to stretch the lead to 5-0. Utah pulled Karel Vejmelka after five goals and turned to Sebastian Cossa for the rest of the second. John Marino and Mikhail Sergachev scored a minute and a half apart early in the third to cut Edmonton’s lead to 5-2. McDavid scored again a little over four minutes later to make it 6-2 for the Oil. He added three assists for a five-point night.
The chances were closer than the score. Tristan Jarry made 26 saves for the Oilers. The Oilers moved to 6-1-1, second in the Pacific, while the Mammoth dropped to 6-3-0, still first in the Central.

items.text: The Mammoth’s three-game winning streak is over.
Connor McDavid has a point in every game this season.
Connor McDavid extended his point streak against Utah to eight games.
Evan Bouchard extended his point streak against Utah to eight games.
